trigger: SAVE failed because worldInteractionTraceR3 was scoped inside a pointerdown callback while the module bridge referenced it globally.
fixes: Moved worldInteractionTraceR3 and traceWorldInteractionR3 to authoritative module scope before the path/build pointerdown handler.
Guarded bridge.interactions() so an optional trace collector cannot throw through the bridge.
Added collectSafe/collectSafeAsync wrappers around optional crawl and diagnostic probes.
Made coreDump tolerate crawl, snapshot, persistence, and optional-diagnostic failures.
Made one-click SAVE download an emergency JSON if the normal dump pipeline itself fails.
Added collectorFailures and a collector-probes-completed assessment row so collector defects are self-identifying.
expectedUserFlow: Play -> R3 -> type comment -> SAVE. Normal result is rollamacoaster_R3_feedback_*.json. If the collector itself breaks, result is rollamacoaster_R3_EMERGENCY_*.json; upload either one.
